value.rationale: The defining shifted Korselt property permits two-prime examples (unlike a=1). The theorem completely and exactly classifies the natural prime-factor-support-two branch above the shift and proves optimal uniform factor barriers with a distinct parity phenomenon, turning potentially unbounded search into a finite two-parameter test for every a. This is structural and not a single arbitrary numerical exercise.
